    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT wifi_ofdm_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT wifi_ofdm_sources)

target_link_libraries(gnuradio-wifi_ofdm gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-wifi_ofdm
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-wifi_ofdm PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_wifi_ofdm_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-wifi_ofdm PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)
